binding_constraints: voluntary willingness-to-pay over modern AI and free alternatives
capture_mechanism: Price maintained execution, integration and accountable outcomes; retain reusable instruments and earnings; transfer or license nonexclusive capabilities only when counterparties prefer them to self-build/copy. No invented legal exclusivity or guaranteed royalty.
construction: Agent-built adapters and executable models, classical optimization, independent client-accounting replay, paid native operation, reusable productive capability rights and deliberate outside-option/copying responses.
economic_novelty_hypothesis: There may be valuable projects whose benefit exceeds the complete autonomous cost but falls below every complete human-build, ordinary self-build and equal-content-copy alternative. This interval is to be measured, not asserted.
expansion: Reuse the construction process across independently sourced industrial tasks; acquire actual qualified counterparties and source-specific adapters; reinvest only earned available cash when justified. Do not clone one public operator into customers.

first_working_examples.limits: one operator, randomized day ordering; no observed software buyers; logistics benchmark only
